summary: Observed-precipitation sources for Washington watersheds, verified 2026-08-22. Gridded: (1) MRMS on AWS (noaa-mrms-pds, GRIB2, 0.01 deg / 7000x3500 CONUS grid, lat 20.005-54.995 N, lon -129.995 to -60.005; RadarOnly_QPE every 2 min, MultiSensor_QPE Pass1 ~20 min latency / Pass2 ~1 h latency, archive on AWS from 2020-10-14; Iowa State mtarchive from 2014-11 with hourly-only MultiSensor files; GaugeCorr_QPE was retired at MRMS v12 in Oct 2020; missing=-1, no-coverage=-3; western Washington radar coverage is structurally weak and MRMS fills gaps with gauge/PRISM Mountain Mapper and HRRR QPF, so RadarQualityIndex/GaugeInflIndex must be carried as quality covariates). (2) NCEP Stage IV (HRAP ~4.76 km polar stereographic, 01h/06h/24h GRIB2 on NOMADS with ~7-day rolling retention; NWPS daily NetCDF/GeoTIFF archive from 2016-06-28; NCAR EOL archive 2002-2026; NCEI holdings sparse). Empirical check: initial-issue 01h/06h Stage IV on NOMADS is 100% missing over WA/OR/CA (western RFCs, incl. NWRFC, deliver later), but 3- and 7-day-old re-issues are back-filled over Washington for 01h, 06h and 24h; so Stage IV is a reanalysis-grade source for WA, not a real-time one. (3) NWRFC publishes 6-h/24-h station QPE as CSV/XML (display_file.php -> /weather/xml/qpe6_YYYYMMDDHHMM.csv) and MRMS overlays via the NWS mapservices ImageServer. Point gauges: api.weather.gov ASOS/AWOS observations (precipitationLastHour/3Hours/6Hours, ~7-day retention, values widely null at WA ASOS, User-Agent required); Synoptic Weather API (derived precip service, station-hour caps, commercial or .edu-only Open Access, redistribution restrictions); NRCS AWDB REST (78 active WA SNOTEL, PREC water-year accumulation hourly/daily, PRCP/PRCPSA daily increments, no key); USGS Water Data OGC API (parameter 00045 'Precipitation, total, inches', 30 active WA 15-min sites, api.data.gov keys, waterservices.usgs.gov decommission Q1 2027); King County HIC (15-min rainfall, WRIAs 7/8/9/10/15, form-driven ASP.NET downloads, Public Domain per KC open-data record); Seattle SPU (17 active + 2 closed gauges, 1-min data since Jan 1978 per SDCI Appendix F; RainWatch terminated 2018-12-01; no public time-series API found). Frequency context: Washington is NOT in NOAA Atlas 14 (PFDS returns 'not within a project area'); NOAA Atlas 2 (1973) still applies with only 2-yr/100-yr x 6-h/24-h grids; Atlas 15 CONUS preliminary estimates are scheduled for September 2026 with final in 2027; WSDOT/Schaefer-Wallis regional L-moment products are the de facto modern WA alternative.

providers.name: MRMS (Multi-Radar Multi-Sensor) QPE via NOAA Open Data Dissemination on AWS (noaa-mrms-pds)
providers.authority: NOAA NSSL (algorithm/operations) and NWS/NCEP (operational production); distributed through NOAA NODD on AWS

access.mechanism: Anonymous S3 object GET and ListObjects; optional SNS topic for new-object notifications. Key pattern: CONUS/<Product>_<level>/<YYYYMMDD>/MRMS_<Product>_<level>_<YYYYMMDD>-<HHMMSS>.grib2.gz (e.g., CONUS/MultiSensor_QPE_01H_Pass2_00.00/20260822/MRMS_MultiSensor_QPE_01H_Pass2_00.00_20260822-070000.grib2.gz). Top-level prefixes: ALASKA/, ANC/, CARIB/, CONUS/, CONUS_5KM/, ConvectProb/, GUAM/, HAWAII/, ProbSevere/, unsupported/.
access.auth: None (public bucket, no AWS credentials required; SNS subscription supports Lambda and SQS protocols only)
access.rate_limits: No published limit; standard S3 public-bucket behavior (requester is not charged for anonymous GETs per NODD registry terms)
formats: GRIB2 (gzip-compressed .grib2.gz; data representation template 5.41 PNG packing)
GeoTIFF/NIDS exist on LDM/NCEP web services per MRMS v12.2 supplemental, not in this bucket

providers.cadence: RadarOnly_QPE_01H, PrecipRate, PrecipFlag, RadarQualityIndex: every 2 minutes. RadarOnly_QPE_03H..72H, MultiSensor_QPE_*_Pass1/Pass2, GaugeInflIndex, RadarAccumulationQualityIndex: every 60 minutes (top of hour). RadarOnly_QPE_15M: 15 min. RadarOnly_QPE_Since12Z: hourly.
providers.latency: Observed 2026-08-22 08:30Z from object timestamps: RadarOnly_QPE_01H valid 08:26Z landed 08:28:47Z (~2-3 min); MultiSensor_QPE_01H_Pass1 valid 08:00Z landed 08:16:25Z (~16 min; NSSL table says '20-minute latency'); MultiSensor_QPE_01H_Pass2 valid 07:00Z landed 07:57:34Z (~57 min; NSSL table says '1-hour latency'). Older documentation (Planetary Computer STAC, pre-v12 NSSL updates) still quotes 60/120 min for Pass1/Pass2; NSSL reduced these to 20/60 min.
providers.spatial_resolution: 0.01 deg x 0.01 deg (~1 km N-S); CONUS grid Ni=7000 x Nj=3500 (24,500,000 points); first point lat 54.995 N, lon 230.005 E (-129.995); last point lat 20.005 N, lon 299.995 E (-60.005); scan mode 0 (row-major from NW corner). Read directly from GRIB2 section 3 of a 2026-08-22 file.
providers.temporal_resolution: Accumulation windows: 15 min (RadarOnly only), 1, 3, 6, 12, 24, 48, 72 h, and Since12Z (RadarOnly). PrecipRate is an instantaneous 2-min rate (mm/h).
providers.historical_depth: AWS bucket: all CONUS QPE products listed begin 2020-10-14 (RadarOnly_QPE_01H, MultiSensor_QPE_01H_Pass1/Pass2, MultiSensor_QPE_24H_Pass2, RadarQualityIndex, PrecipRate all have 20201014 as first date prefix) and run to present (20260822). GaugeCorr_QPE_* does not exist in the bucket (retired with MRMS v12 Pass1/Pass2 structure). No NCEI general MRMS archive; see the separate 'MRMS archive holdings' provider for Iowa State (2014-11 onward) and the 2002-2011 NEXRAD QPE CDR.
providers.missing_data_semantics: Per NSSL operational GRIB2 table: Missing = -1, No Coverage = -3 (for PrecipRate, RadarOnly_QPE_*, MultiSensor_QPE_*, PrecipFlag, RadarQualityIndex, GaugeInflIndex, RadarAccumulationQualityIndex). THREDDS CDL of a Pass2 file shows missing_value=-1.0 and _FillValue=-3.0. pysteps docs note -3 must not be confused with zero precipitation. Model_* fields use -99/-999.
providers.quality_flags: Companion grids: RadarQualityIndex (0-1, 2-min; RQI = blockage term x beam-height term), RadarAccumulationQualityIndex_xxH (hourly), GaugeInflIndex_xxH_Pass1/Pass2 (gauge influence on multi-sensor QPE), PrecipFlag (surface precip type: convective/stratiform/tropical/hail/snow; flag table). MultiSensor QPE is a decision-tree blend of locally gauge-corrected radar QPE, Mountain Mapper (hourly gauges interpolated on PRISM climatology) and HRRR 1-h QPF where radar coverage is poor; ~20,000 HADS+MADIS gauge obs/hour ingested, ~85% pass QC (Martinaitis et al. 2020). Product status in GRIB2 section 1: production status 2 (research/operational per NOAA table), type 7.
providers.units: mm for QPE accumulations; mm/h for PrecipRate; non-dimensional for RQI/GaugeInflIndex; flag codes for PrecipFlag
providers.licensing: NOAA data, publicly available; AWS registry states attribution is requested for unaltered data and modified data must not be misrepresented as original NOAA data. Contact mrms@noaa.gov / nodd@noaa.gov.
limitations: Western Washington radar coverage is structurally limited: KATX (Camano Island) is blocked by the Olympic Mountains toward the coast; KLGX (Langley Hill, commissioned Sept 2011, scans as low as 0.2 deg) filled the former coastal gap but interior Olympic/Cascade valleys (Skagit, Nooksack, Snoqualmie headwaters) remain beam-blocked or overshot; MSQPE therefore relies on gauge/PRISM and HRRR fill there. Always ingest RadarQualityIndex and GaugeInflIndex alongside QPE.

Canadian (ECCC) radars that cover the Nooksack/Skagit border region dropped out of MRMS from 5-15 June 2023 when ECCC changed scan strategies; NSSL later reintegrated them in a subsequent build. Expect a discontinuity in northern-border QPE in mid-2023.
Pass1 (~20 min) includes only a subset of gauges; Pass2 (~1 h) is the better hydrologic forcing. Planetary Computer and some docs still quote 60/120 min latencies, which are stale.

Product naming changed at MRMS v12.0 (Oct 2020): GaugeCorr_QPE_* replaced by MultiSensor_QPE_*_Pass1/Pass2; GaugeInflIndex_xxH became GaugeInflIndex_xxH_Pass1. Archives before Oct 2020 use the old names.
AWS archive only starts 2020-10-14; hourly-only coverage of MultiSensor products exists at Iowa State from 2020-10 and RadarOnly/PrecipRate at 2-min since 2014-11.
Files are full-CONUS (~0.4-8 MB gz each); subsetting to Washington requires decoding the whole grid or using byte-range-unfriendly PNG packing (template 5.41) - plan a regional re-chunking step.
MRMS operational code changes (v12.3.0 on 5 Aug 2025; v12.3.1 planned Spring 2026) alter QPE behavior over time; version boundaries should be tracked in provenance.

MSQPE design: ~20,000 HADS+MADIS gauges/hour, ~85% pass QC; Mountain Mapper = hourly gauges on PRISM climatology; HRRR 1-h QPF fill; RQI = blockage x height; ~85-min total latency in the 2020 research configuration; improved skill over western US where beam blockage/poor coverage

KLGX commissioned Sept 2011 at Langley Hill near Copalis Beach; previously the Olympic Peninsula coast was the only US coastline without radar; KATX on Camano Island blocked by the Olympics; KLGX scans as low as 0.2 deg
MRMS v12.2 supplemental: GRIB2 and GeoTIFF products via LDM and NCEP web services; NIDS via LDM only
NWS mapservices ImageServer 'obs/mrms_qpe' exposes rft_1hr..rft_72hr layers (used by NWRFC's map)
KRTX (Portland) coverage of SW Washington (Cowlitz/Lewis) is also terrain-limited

providers.relevance_to_cascade_oracle: Primary real-time gridded precipitation forcing and nowcast input for all WA basins; use RadarOnly_QPE_01H (2-min) for nowcasting and MultiSensor_QPE_01H_Pass2 (hourly, ~1 h latency) for hydrologic forcing; carry RadarQualityIndex/GaugeInflIndex as per-cell quality covariates because Skagit, Nooksack, Snoqualmie and Olympic basins sit in low-RQI terrain; build a Washington-subset re-chunking pipeline from the S3 bucket with SNS/SQS triggers.

access.rate_limits: IEM: none published (single university server; be polite). Planetary Computer: standard PC limits.

providers.authority: NWS River Forecast Centers (Stage III analyses, manual QC) mosaicked by NCEP/EMC; archived/redistributed by NWS Office of Water Prediction (NWPS), NCAR EOL, NCEI

access.mechanism: NOMADS HTTPS directory pcpanl.YYYYMMDD/ with st4_conus.YYYYMMDDHH.{01h,06h,24h}.grb2 (+ st4_ak, .gif); NWPS HTTPS downloads: stageIV/current/nws_precip_{1hour,last2hours,last3hours,last6hours,last12hours,last24hours,since12z}_{conus,ak,pr}.nc and stageIV/YYYY/MM/DD/nws_precip_1day_YYYYMMDD_conus.{nc,tif}, nws_precip_last10days_..., plus ncep_stage_iv_source_files_YYYYMMDD.tar; NCAR EOL dataset 21.093 (DOI 10.5065/D6PG1QDD); NCEI directory nws-quantitative-precipitation-estimates/access/YYYY/MM/conus_YYYYMMDD_24h.grb2.
access.auth: None for NOMADS/NWPS/NCEI; NCAR EOL requires a free EOL account for downloads (INFERENCE)
access.rate_limits: None published; NWPS recommends wget scripting; anonymous FTP discontinued
formats: GRIB2 (NOMADS; GRIB1 before 2020-07-20; XMRG before 2017-03-22 at EOL)
NetCDF (CF-1.6) and GeoTIFF on HRAP polar stereographic grid (NWPS)

providers.cadence: 01h files every hour; 06h files at 00/06/12/18Z; 24h files at 12Z (two per day folder observed: 48 x 01h, 8 x 06h, 2 x 24h per day on NOMADS including re-issues); NWPS 1-day product daily at 12Z.
providers.latency: Initial 01h issue ~55 min after the hour (st4_conus.2026082100.01h.grb2 posted 22-Aug 00:56Z); 06h ~2-3 h after period end; files are re-issued as late RFC data arrive (NOMADS folder keeps ~7 days and older files were observed back-filled).
providers.spatial_resolution: HRAP grid: polar stereographic true at 60 N, central meridian -105, sphere radius 6371200 m; Ni 1121 x Nj 881; Dx=Dy=4762.5 m; first grid point 23.117 N, 240.977 E. NWPS NetCDF carries x/y in metres with proj4 '+proj=stere +lat_0=90 +lat_ts=60 +lon_0=-105 +a=6371200 +b=6371200'.
providers.temporal_resolution: 1 h, 6 h, 24 h accumulations (NWPS derives 1-365 day, month-to-date and water-year sums)
providers.historical_depth: NCAR EOL: 2001-12-31 to 2026-05-31 (hourly, 6-hourly, 24-hourly; CONUS, AK, PR from April 2017). NWPS daily Stage IV: 2016-06-28 to present (CONUS), Alaska Mar 2017+, Puerto Rico Apr 2017+; Stage III daily 2005-01-01 to 2017-06-27. NCEI holdings are sparse: year folders 2005-2010, 2013-2015, 2019, 2021, 2022 only, 24h GRIB2 files. NOMADS: rolling ~7 days.
providers.missing_data_semantics: GRIB2 bitmap with missingValue 9999 (eccodes); NWPS NetCDF uses _FillValue -3.4e38 outside the domain and a -10000 sentinel for 'no data yet' cells inside the domain. Empirically on 2026-08-22 07Z the NWPS 1-hour/last6/last24 grids were -10000 over 100% of eastern WA, OR and N. CA and 72% of western WA (rest off-grid ocean), while Georgia was 100% valid; the initial NOMADS 01h and 06h files for 2026-08-21 18Z were 100% missing over WA/OR/CA. Files 3 and 7 days old (2026-08-19 12Z and 2026-08-15 12Z) had 85.9% valid over western WA (remaining 14% is ocean) and 100% over eastern WA for 01h, 06h and 24h, i.e. western RFC data are back-filled in re-issues.
providers.quality_flags: None in-grid; quality depends on RFC manual QC. NWRFC, CNRFC and CBRFC use Mountain Mapper (gauge/PRISM) rather than radar-dominant Stage III, producing discontinuities at RFC boundaries (Nelson et al. 2016 recommend analyzing western RFCs separately).
providers.units: kg m-2 (= mm) in GRIB2; inches in NWPS NetCDF ('Inches' attribute)
providers.licensing: US Government work, no access or legal constraints (NCAR EOL record: 'Access Constraints: none', 'Legal Constraints: none')
limitations: Not usable as real-time forcing for Washington: the western RFCs' contribution (NWRFC Mountain Mapper QPE) is absent from initial hourly/6-hourly issues and appears only in later re-issues; treat Stage IV as a T+2-7 day reanalysis product for WA.
Hourly values over NWRFC are effectively disaggregated 6-h gauge analyses, not radar-hourly fields (INFERENCE from Mountain Mapper workflow).
HRAP ~4.76 km grid is coarse relative to Cascade/Olympic orography; reprojection from polar stereographic is required.
NCEI holdings are incomplete; use NCAR EOL (2002-2026) or NWPS (2016+) for continuous archives.
NOMADS retention is only ~7 days; a daily pull of the back-filled files is needed to capture re-issues.
